spec_match.rationale: Drives the exact shipped surface — color(display-p3-linear r g b / a) with the spec's own §10.5 example values as the default — and probes it with CSS.supports of that exact function plus an inline-style parse attempt, both able to return false.

interactive.rationale: Four sliders and four presets repaint both swatches and rewrite the declaration + getComputedStyle readout on every input; verified via CDP that preset and slider changes update the readout, value labels, and JS-approximation swatch.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index promises sliders driving one color() function with an honest dropped-declaration state; that is exactly the page.

edge_cases.rationale: The unsupported branch (hatched, labelled, telemetry-asserted) and alpha are covered; out-of-range component behavior is deliberately delegated to the out-of-gamut concept rather than duplicated here.

references.rationale: chromestatus.com/feature/5162372125818880 and the §10.5 spec anchor are in see-also.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite asserts the exact parse, percentage/alpha grammar, serialization round-trip, unclamped storage, and the spec's linear→gamma worked example — every probe can return false and all seven fail cleanly (not error) on Chromium 141.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP-driven on headless Chromium 141 (mobile 360×740 DPR3 + desktop 1280): zero console errors, zero overflow, controls exercised including keyboard ArrowRight on a slider, screenshots read. NOT verified: the supported path — 141 predates the feature, so the native swatch was only observed in its honest hatched state.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts p3-linear-computed-roundtrip on the supported path and p3-linear-unsupported-fallback-shown explicitly on the fallback branch; console output is one intentional log per render.

design_system.rationale: All colors are design-system variables, buttons keep the global dark/ivory pair, the unsupported tag is rose-on-ivory (AA), and the hatched pattern uses --bg-stone/--bg-paper.

accessibility.rationale: Native labelled range inputs, a role=group for presets, aria-live polite readout, swatches exposed as role=img with state-bearing accessible names that change between supported/unsupported; keyboard operation verified (focus + arrow key moved the value).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP device metrics at 360×740 DPR3 touch and 1280×800: scrollWidth equals clientWidth on both, 44px control minimums, slider rows use minmax(0,1fr) so the range track shrinks instead of overflowing.

openQuestions.title: Verify the supported path on Chrome 144+
openQuestions.detail: The build environment was Chromium 141, which predates the feature, so only the honest unsupported branch has browser evidence. On a Chrome 144+ run: confirm the native swatch paints, the getComputedStyle readout serializes as color(display-p3-linear …), the p3-linear-computed-roundtrip telemetry assert passes, and the banner takes the supported branch.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer flexible tracks (minmax, fr) and intrinsic sizing over fixed columns; never mask overflow with overflow:hidden; use flex-wrap for button rows.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Slider rows are grid minmax(5rem,7.5rem) minmax(0,1fr) 4rem with min-width:0 on the range input so the track shrinks below its min-content width; preset rows flex-wrap; swatch pair uses repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%,15rem),1fr)).
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP overflow check at 360×740 DPR3: scrollWidth 360 == clientWidth 360, no elements past the right edge.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible slider controls live output announce state
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native elements with real labels; surface changing state through text/live regions rather than visuals alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Native <input type=range> wrapped in <label for>, output with aria-live=polite carrying the declaration + result text, role=img aria-labels on swatches restating the rendered/unsupported state.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP: focused sb-r and sent ArrowRight; value moved 0.9 → 0.9001 and the label span updated.

guidanceConsulted.query: wide gamut color CSS display-p3 progressive enhancement
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Feature-detect with exact CSS.supports queries and layer fallback declarations so unsupported parsers drop only the enhanced value.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The probe is the exact color(display-p3-linear 0 1 0) string; the code sample teaches the rgb → display-p3 → display-p3-linear fallback ladder; the page itself never paints a lookalike as native.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Banner and readout verified showing false/dropped on Chromium 141 with the JS approximation clearly labelled.

summary: Canonical-usage concept: sliders drive the exact color() function with the spec's own example as default, honest hatched dropped-declaration state on pre-144 browsers, and a clearly-labelled JS sRGB approximation so the page teaches everywhere. Verified interaction-by-interaction over CDP on Chromium 141; the supported branch still needs a 144+ pass.
